name: Love Liar : Seksihan Jinsil Yahan Geojinmal
original_name: 러브 라이어 : 섹시한 진실 야한 거짓말
source:
If I could get revenge on my ex-boyfriend, I would sell my soul to the sexy devil! But…the devil actually exists?!? I tried to use a love potion with the help of the devil, but the potion worked on the wrong person! One of the four people must have drank the potion… But who drank it? Let's find out by dating all of them!

Somebody must be telling sexy lies. The beginning of dangerous, but steamy romance! Discover the naughty truth buried under the lies!

[Edited from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.storytaco.p24client]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
只要能向我的前男友复仇，就算把灵魂卖给性感的恶魔我也愿意！可是……恶魔居然真的存在？！？在恶魔的帮助下，我试着使用了爱情魔药，结果药效却发作在了错误的人身上！那四个人当中肯定有一个人喝下了魔药……但究竟是谁喝的呢？就通过和他们所有人约会来找出真相吧！

肯定有人在撒性感的谎。一段危险而又火辣的恋情就此开启！揭开掩藏在谎言之下的撩人真相吧！
